Root.title: SpeechNexusRealtimeEvent
Root.description: Public WebSocket event union for /v1/realtime. The standard subset mirrors the OpenAI Realtime transcription session and transcription event shapes; SpeechNexus capabilities and controls use only the nexus.* namespace. Unlisted OpenAI events such as response.*, conversation history, tool calls, and semantic VAD are rejected rather than silently ignored.

External_shared_identifiers_schema_json_.description: Opaque stable resource identifier. Prefixes are descriptive, not authorization claims.

OpenAIPcmFormat.description: OpenAI Realtime PCM format projection: mono PCM16 little-endian, 24 kHz.

External_shared_identifiers_schema_json_.description: Monotonic decimal revision represented as a string.

Base64Audio.description: Base64-encoded PCM16 little-endian bytes. The decoded byte length must be even and must match the negotiated wire format. The negotiated max_message_bytes applies to the entire JSON message, including the event envelope.

TranscriptionLogprob.description: OpenAI Realtime log-probability shape. Emit only when the binding supplies genuine token evidence.

usage.description: OpenAI-compatible usage. SpeechNexus reports duration measured from the accepted segment sample span; token usage is reported only when the binding provides real token evidence.

External_shared_errors_schema_json_Opera.description: Query GET /v1/nexus/operations/{operation_id}. This identity is the original execution; retrying never creates a second execution.

External_shared_receipts_schema_json_Pub.description: Allowlisted public projection only. Omit content, prompt, instructions, vendor payloads and private runtime identities. Unknown facts go into stable missing/unknown paths, never arbitrary dictionaries.

SampleSpan.description: Half-open wire-sample interval [start, end). Contract tests require end > start; JSON Schema cannot express that relation across properties.

External_shared_operation_states_schema_.description: Terminal subset of OperationStatus. A failed operation may still have cleanup_state=pending or quarantined.
